text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Even if it's due to renovations,
having the Tenno Sho (Autumn) at Nakayama feels so fresh.
It's always at Tokyo, so it feels kind of weird.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: From the Classic class, both Gimlet and Kris S are running this time...! Having both of them challenge it at once is so hype...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see what kind of run Gimlet and the others put up against the Senior Class!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I bet Tanino-senpai is gonna blow everyone's minds away here this time too...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter if they're Senior Class!
Right, Gim-senpai...?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Once we finish running this 'Tenno Sho (Autumn),'
let us announce the Yasuda-Takarazuka rotation far and wide. Make the preparations.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...I can feel it coming through even from here.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It's Kris S's pressure, you see.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
She is waiting for me.
...Let us go answer the call.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes peeled during today's race.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...You've got truly terrifying potential, you know that?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An absolute pressure, as if piling even further onto the weight of the Senior Class—
This is completely different from how it felt back at the Kobe Shimbun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(If my intuition is correct...
then today's race should clarify the other
weight residing in the waves of your soul.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――Now, as promised, let me see for myself.
The true nature of your power...!
